jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, Fintechs & Exchanges
jobs.description:
OP Labs builds Optimism, a blockchain network that powers the next generation of financial infrastructure. Hundreds of companies, from the world's largest enterprises like Sony, Coinbase, Kraken, Uniswap, OKX, and Bitpanda to the most ambitious early-stage builders, use the OP stack to launch their own blockchains and bring their users onchain. Today, over 65% of Layer 2 activity on Ethereum runs through the OP stack.

We are a small team building at the speed of the ecosystem we support. The NYC office is our center of gravity, and we have a strong preference for people who can join us there on a hybrid schedule. We've raised $178M from a16z, Paradigm, and others. We have our work cut out for us and are looking for exceptional people to join us.



Role and Responsibilities 

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to drive onchain adoption by fintechs and centralized crypto exchanges in the Optimism ecosystem.

Fintechs and crypto exchanges are rapidly moving their business onchain to serve as the most important distribution partners for bringing millions of users and billions in assets onchain. In this role, you’ll define the roadmap for enterprise-facing products that help these businesses expand their product suite and integrate DeFi functionality without sacrificing user experience.

As the creators of Optimism Mainnet and the infrastructure that powers all OP Stack chains, OP Labs is dedicated to enhancing Ethereum’s performance exponentially. 



What are the role responsibilities?

 - Lead the Fintech & Exchange Roadmap: Define and execute product strategy across integrations, SDKs, and infrastructure that help fintechs and exchanges embed onchain services into their platforms.

 - Champion the Customer: Build deep expertise in fintechs and exchanges, understanding their needs around compliance, custody, and user experience. Translate those needs into products and partnerships that deliver measurable value.

 - Drive Adoption of Onchain Services: Launch and scale products that make it easier for enterprises to offer yield, trading, payments, and other onchain financial products to their users.

 - Partner with the Ecosystem: Collaborate and coordinate with DeFi protocols, infra providers, custodians, and chain operators to accelerate ecosystem growth.

 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with engineering, BD, design, and marketing to bring new products from concept to launch and iterate quickly.



What skills do you bring?

 - Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, consumer finance apps, or centralized crypto exchanges. Direct experience with onchain/DeFi products is a strong plus.

 - Customer-Driven: Strong ability to engage with enterprise partners, uncover pain points, and translate them into actionable product requirements.

 - Technical Aptitude: Comfortable working across custody, wallet infra, and protocol integrations to inform product decisions.

 - Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of fintech product mechanics (e.g., trading, lending, payments) or exchange infrastructure.

 - Collaborative & Adaptable: Thrives in fast-moving environments with shifting priorities and rapidly developing regulatory landscape

 - Strong Communicator: Excellent written and verbal skills; able to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Mission-Aligned: Belief that blockchains can make financial services more open, efficient, and accessible to anyone.



What will you like about us?

 - We take care of our employees. Competitive compensation, fully paid medical, dental, and vision, and a 4% 401K match.

 - We take pride in the accomplishments of our teammates and support each other in doing the best work of our careers.

 - Our team is a diverse group of people from varied backgrounds. We cherish our eclecticism and consider it a great strength.

 - We're remote-friendly with an NYC office where we like to collaborate in person.

 - We think long-term. Our founders have been scaling Ethereum since 2015.

 - Learn more about our interviewing here! https://oplabs.notion.site/Interviewing-at-OP-26cf153ee1628080ab4fd1ddca5b5998


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Health, fully covered. OP Labs pays 100% of your health insurance premiums, with a range of medical, dental, and vision plans to choose from.

 - 401(k) with a 4% company match.

 - $2,000 annual wellness stipend, to spend on whatever keeps you healthy and energized.

 - $1,000 WFH setup stipend and $1,000 learning budget

 - Competitive compensation, including performance bonus and token grants — you share in the growth of what we're building together.

 - Flexible time off. No fixed allotment. Take what you need.

 - 14 paid holidays, plus two Collective Pause weeks each year — the first week of July and the week between Christmas and New Year, when the whole company steps back at once.

 - Four-week sabbatical after three years, three of them paid, with your equity and tokens vesting throughout.

 - New York hybrid, or location-flexible (team dependent). Commercial and growth teams work from our SoHo office three days a week; engineering and technical roles are location-flexible.

 - We get together in person. Every team carries a travel budget so remote teammates can join us in New York, and we bring the whole company together at offsites twice a year.

 


We are aware of fraudulent individuals falsely claiming to represent OP Labs in recruitment activities.
Please note:

 - All official communication will come from an @oplabs.co http://oplabs.co email address, or from a verified LinkedIn profile.

 - We will never ask for payment, banking information, or personal identification details at any stage of our hiring process.

 - All current openings are listed exclusively on our official careers page https://www.optimism.io/careers and linked from our verified social profiles.

 - If you’re ever unsure about a communication that claims to be from OP Labs, please contact us directly at people@oplabs.co to verify authenticity.

Your safety and trust are very important to us. Thank you for helping us prevent fraud.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Product Marketing is how the OP Stack gets understood, evaluated, and chosen. This role, the Product Marketing Lead, owns the narrative for our products across enterprise buyers, institutional partners, and the developer community. You will define how we position against alternatives, package what we build into offerings the market can buy, and equip the go-to-market team to sell them. This requires a rare combination of enterprise B2B rigor and genuine fluency with deeply technical infrastructure.



WHAT ARE THE ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES?

 - Own positioning, messaging, and narrative for Optimism and the OP Stack, translating complex infrastructure into a clear value proposition for enterprise, institutional, and developer audiences.

 - Own end-to-end go-to-market for product launches, including segmentation, launch strategy, tiering, cross-functional coordination, and post-launch measurement.

 - Define and maintain the ideal customer profile and buyer personas across our core segments, including financial institutions, fintechs, and enterprises evaluating onchain infrastructure.

 - Build the sales and BD enablement engine: pitch narratives, solution briefs, competitive battle cards, case studies, and objection handling that shortens enterprise sales cycles.

 - Own competitive and market intelligence, maintaining a current view of alternative L2s, rollup frameworks, and infrastructure providers, and turning that view into positioning decisions.

 - Partner with Product to shape the roadmap with market evidence, and with Partnerships to package joint offerings with ecosystem and infrastructure partners.

 - Support analyst, press, and executive communications with a consistent product narrative, in partnership with the comms team.

 - Build and lead the product marketing function over time, including hiring, standards, and operating cadence.

 - Proactively communicate market shifts, competitive threats, and launch readiness to executive leadership.



WHAT SKILLS DO YOU BRING?



MARKETING & COMMERCIAL ACUMEN:

 - 7+ years in product marketing at enterprise B2B SaaS companies, including time owning positioning and launches for a technical product line end-to-end.

 - Proven track record marketing to enterprise buying committees through long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving procurement, security, and legal review.

 - Strong commercial instincts around packaging, pricing narrative, and competitive displacement, with the judgment to know which deals a message needs to win.

 - Demonstrated impact on pipeline and revenue, not just content output.


PRODUCT & TECHNICAL FLUENCY:

 - Comfortable engaging directly with engineers and technical buyers, and able to develop credible messaging about infrastructure without oversimplifying it.

 - Strategic product thinking, including the ability to run customer discovery and bring market evidence into roadmap and build-partner-buy decisions.

 - Experience marketing to developers alongside enterprise buyers is a strong plus.


EXECUTION & COMMUNICATION:

 - High-agency cross-functional operator, proficient at driving work across product, sales, BD, design, and external partners to ship launches that create measurable impact.

 - Exceptional writer, able to produce concise strategy documents, narratives, and enablement material that keep all stakeholders aligned.

 - Proven ability to manage multi-quarter marketing roadmaps and drive clarity in ambiguous environments.

 - Experience building or scaling a product marketing team.

 - A genuine passion for blockchain technology, decentralization, and the future of open systems.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience selling or marketing into banks, payment networks, or fintechs, and familiarity with how regulated financial institutions evaluate and procure infrastructure.

 - Exposure to compliance, risk, payments, or stablecoin and fiat-rail products.
